hero.text: Welcome! We're a group of creators making original Minecraft events, videos and community projects together, and we'd love to have you along.

status.pageText: Here's how everything at Mirage is running right now, from the website to the server and Discord.

disclaimer.title: Content Disclaimer
paragraphs: Our actors and POV creators are not highly trained professionals, and they may make errors or mistakes within their videos, performances, gameplay or actions.
Please do not treat them with disrespect. Patience and constructive feedback help everyone improve and keep Mirage a positive creative space.
Mirage content is created for entertainment and storytelling. Some scenes, characters and events may be fictional or performed specifically for a production.

roles.name: Script Writer
roles.introText: Tell us about your writing experience, how you approach storytelling, and what you could bring to Mirage Events.

questions.label: Timezone
questions.placeholder: e.g. GMT / BST

questions.label: Availability
questions.placeholder: e.g. 8–12 hours per week

questions.label: Previous writing experience
questions.placeholder: Tell us about any scripts, stories, SMPs, events or other projects you have written for.

questions.label: Portfolio / writing samples
questions.placeholder: Links to previous work, documents or videos (optional).

questions.label: Why do you want to join Mirage as a Script Writer?
questions.placeholder: Tell us what interests you about writing for Mirage Events.

questions.label: How would you build a storyline for a Minecraft event?
questions.placeholder: Explain how you would develop characters, conflict, pacing and a satisfying conclusion.

questions.label: Writing sample
questions.placeholder: Write a short scene for a Minecraft event. Include at least two characters and a clear source of tension or conflict.

questions.label: Working with a team
questions.placeholder: How do you handle feedback, changes to your writing and working from someone else's plot or ideas?

questions.label: Additional Information
questions.placeholder: Anything else the team should know

roles.name: Moderator
roles.introText: Tell us about your staff experience, judgement, and how you would help keep the Mirage community safe and welcoming. Previous staff experience is useful but not required.

questions.label: Timezone
questions.placeholder: e.g. GMT / BST

questions.label: Availability
questions.placeholder: e.g. evenings and weekends

questions.label: Past staff experience
questions.placeholder: What servers or communities have you helped staff? Describe your role and responsibilities. If you have no past staff experience, explain that and share relevant skills.

questions.label: Moderation experience and tools
questions.placeholder: Describe experience with reports, rule enforcement, tickets, logs or moderation bots, or how you would learn.

questions.label: Why do you want to be a Mirage Moderator?
questions.placeholder: What interests you about helping this community, and what strengths would you bring?

questions.label: Scenario: a player reports harassment, but you did not witness it. What would you do?
questions.placeholder: Explain how you would gather context, preserve evidence, protect privacy and decide whether to escalate.

questions.label: Handling conflict and staying fair
questions.placeholder: How would you respond if a friend broke a rule, or a player disagreed with a moderation decision?

questions.label: Additional Information
questions.placeholder: Anything else the team should know

forms.privacyNote: Your details go to the Mirage team and are shared with authorised reviewers in a private Discord channel.

core.sub: Reviewers use these to find and contact you. You must be 13 or older to apply.

support.title: How can we help?
support.text: For assistance with Mirage, submit a ticket through our official support portal. Our team will review your enquiry and respond through the support system.
support.cardText: Use the portal to submit a support ticket, report an issue, or request assistance. Our team will reply through the support system.
support.securityNote: Never share your password, verification codes, API keys, or account recovery details. Mirage staff will never ask for your password.
